senses.gloss: m. (כָּחַל) staff used for painting the eye.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 13:2">Kel. XIII, 2</cite> <he>מ׳ שניטל הכף</he> a painting staff the spoon-shaped side of which is broken off; <cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 3:5">Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. III, 5</cite>, v. <cite ref="G00468"><he>זָכָר</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 68a:5">Snh. 68ᵃ</cite> <he>כמ׳ בשפופרת</he>; <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:3">Cant. R. to I, 3</cite>, v. <cite ref="G00471"><he>זַכְרוּת</he></cite> a. <cite ref="H01410"><he>חָסַר</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 91a:13">B. Mets. 91ᵃ</cite> <he>כמ׳ בשפופרת</he> as the painting stick is inserted in the tube; <cite ref="Makkot 7a">Macc. 7ᵃ</cite>; a. e.
